summary: Master Scope 3 emissions measurement and supplier engagement with practical tools, supplier data methods, and reporting-ready outputs. Enquire now.
lede: Scope 3 emissions measurement and supplier engagement covers mapping value-chain boundaries, collecting emissions data, and screening supplier hotspots. For sustainability, procurement, supply-chain, and reporting professionals, it supports building inventories through data-quality checks, hybrid calculations, supplier segmentation, and evidence tracking. Participants practice creating data templates, hotspot registers, and supplier engagement plans to prioritize reduction actions and report progress.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who work directly with Scope 3 emissions data, supplier reporting, procurement decisions, or climate disclosure processes. It fits teams that need practical methods for inventory building, supplier engagement, and progress reporting rather than broad sustainability theory.
modules: Supplier Engagement Strategy and Target Setting
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop, spreadsheet software, and any sample supplier, procurement, or emissions data you can safely use for exercises. Familiarity with basic greenhouse gas accounting terminology will help you move faster, but you do not need coding skills or advanced life-cycle assessment experience.
